description_en: Resets a quota throttling rule on a gateway
description_zh: 重置网关上某条配额限流规则
kebab_example: aliyun apig reset-gateway-quota-rule --gateway-id gw-123456 --rule-id qr-d8j7fpmm1hksxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetGatewayQuotaRule

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The conflict snapshot hash, used to prevent concurrent dirty overwrites when confirming an overwrite. Obtain this value from the response of a previous dryRun=true call.

You do not need to specify this parameter in the following cases: no conflicts exist, you are performing a dry run (dryRun=true), or you are not confirming an overwrite (overwrite=false).

When dryRun is set to false and overwrite is set to true, if this parameter is not specified or the value has expired and no longer matches, the backend returns accepted=false with a new conflict preview. You must perform the dry run again to confirm the new conflicts
parameters.help_zh:
冲突快照哈希，用于“确认覆盖时防并发脏覆盖”。通过先执行 dryRun=true 在返回数据提取。

当以下情况不需要填写：没有冲突；只是 dryRun=true 预检；overwrite=false，即不确认覆盖。

当当 dryRun = false 且 overwrite=true 时不带改参数或者该参数过期不匹配，后端会返回：accepted=false 并带新的冲突预览，需要重新执行 dryrun 确认新的冲突
parameters.name: conflict_hash

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without persisting or applying the configuration. A dry run checks whether conflicting rules exist on the bound subjects. The same subject cannot have two calendar-period quotas with the same period. For example, a subject that already has a daily calendar quota cannot have another daily calendar quota rule added
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的主体上是否存在冲突的规则（同一主体不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的主体不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when conflicts exist. If you allow overwriting, the conflicting subjects (consumers or consumer groups) are unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule
parameters.help_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者或消费者组）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en: The period multiplier, which specifies the number of periods after which the quota is reset. This parameter is returned when the rule uses a custom period. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 周期倍数，代表每多少个周期进行配额重置。当规则为自定义周期时返回，最小为1，最大为60
parameters.name: period_multiplier

parameters.help_en: The period type. Calendar periods support daily, weekly, and monthly statistics. Valid values: day, week, and month. Custom periods support only daily statistics. The value is fixed to day
parameters.help_zh: 周期类型。自然周期支持按日、周、月统计，取值为 day、week 或 month；自定义周期仅支持按日统计，固定取值为 day
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.help_en: The total available quota per period after the reset
parameters.help_zh: 重置后周期可用总额度
parameters.name: quota_limit

parameters.help_en: The time zone for the calendar period, in UTC+x format
parameters.help_zh: 自然周期对应的时区(UTC+x格式)
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en:
The period alignment type after the reset. Valid values:
calendar: calendar period.
epoch: custom period
parameters.help_zh: 重置周期类型。支持自然周期（windowAlignment=calendar）和自定义周期（windowAlignment=epoch）
parameters.name: window_alignment

code.description_en: The status code or error code

accepted.description_en: Indicates whether the write request is accepted by the system. A value of false typically indicates a retryable scenario, such as an unconfirmed conflict overwrite
accepted.description_zh: 本次写请求语义是否可被系统接收，false 常见于冲突未确认覆盖等可重试场景
accepted.title_en: 本次写请求语义是否可被系统接收
accepted.title_zh: 本次写请求语义是否可被系统接收

items.description_en: The details of a conflicting subject

conflictPeriodType.description_en:
The period type of the existing conflicting rule on the subject. Valid values:
day: The period of the existing conflicting rule is daily.
week: The period of the existing conflicting rule is weekly.
month: The period of the existing conflicting rule is monthly
conflictPeriodType.description_zh: 主体上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示主体已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月
conflictPeriodType.title_en: 消费者上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费者已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月
conflictPeriodType.title_zh: 消费者上已有冲突规则的周期类型。conflictPeriodType  = "day"/"week"/"month"分别表示消费者已有冲突规则的周期为日/周/月

conflictType.description_en:
The type of the existing conflicting rule on the subject. Valid values:
calendar: The existing conflicting rule uses a calendar period.
epoch: The existing conflicting rule uses a custom period
conflictType.description_zh: 主体上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示主体已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期
conflictType.title_en: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。
conflictType.title_zh: 消费者上已有冲突规则的类型。conflictType  = "calendar"表示消费者已有冲突规则为自然周期；conflictType = "epoch"表示已有冲突规则为自定义周期。

consumerId.description_en: The consumer ID. You can use subjectId instead
consumerId.description_zh: 消费者ID（现可统一使用 subjectId 替代）

consumerName.description_en: The consumer name. You can use subjectName instead
consumerName.description_zh: 消费者名称（现可统一使用 subjectName 替代）

subjectId.description_en: The ID of the conflicting subject

subjectName.description_en: The name of the conflicting subject

subjectType.description_en:
The type of the conflicting subject. Valid values:
consumer
consumer_group
subjectType.description_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group
subjectType.title_en: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。
subjectType.title_zh: 冲突主体类型，取值为consumer或consumer_group。
